meaning:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;]
1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, Heb.12:16.
2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: 1Pe.5:2 (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it,
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
